functions.name: DateTimeZone.FixedLocalNow

functions.name: DateTimeZone.FixedUtcNow
functions.summary: Returns the current date and time in UTC (the GMT timezone).

functions.name: DateTimeZone.From
functions.signature: DateTimeZone.From(value as any, optional culture as nullable text) as nullable datetimezone

functions.name: DateTimeZone.FromFileTime

functions.name: DateTimeZone.FromText
functions.signature: DateTimeZone.FromText(text as nullable text, optional options as any) as nullable datetimezone

functions.summary: Returns the current date & time in the local timezone.

functions.signature: DateTimeZone.RemoveZone(dateTimeZone as nullable datetimezone) as nullable datetime

functions.signature: DateTimeZone.SwitchZone(dateTimeZone as nullable datetimezone, timezoneHours as number, optional timezoneMinutes as nullable number) as nullable datetimezone

functions.signature: DateTimeZone.ToLocal(dateTimeZone as nullable datetimezone) as nullable datetimezone

functions.name: DateTimeZone.ZoneHours
functions.signature: DateTimeZone.ZoneHours(dateTimeZone as nullable datetimezone) as nullable number

functions.signature: DateTimeZone.ZoneMinutes(dateTimeZone as nullable datetimezone) as nullable number
